description: This file declares the FrameRate class, which is part of a plugin within the WPEFramework namespace. The class handles frame rate measurement, collection, and reporting functionalities, including methods for starting/stopping collection, updating FPS values, and responding to various display changes. It also defines several private member variables and callback functions related to frame rate management.

classes.description: A plugin class that manages frame rate collection and reporting within the WPEFramework plugin system.
